Port progress history

One point per commit: overall effort-weighted progress. back to the dashboard · progress.json

100% = the entire game can be launched into the menu, joined into a game and matchmade on the reconstructed server, and played with sound/audio and visuals 100% working. In other words: the client — the exact same client as the 12.60 original, feature-complete and unstripped, rebuilt as a UE project — reaches the lobby, matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server (which carries every structure and feature the original dedicated server would have) and plays a match with all visuals and audio. The supplied 12.60 build is the completeness reference; the original binary under Wine is an analysis oracle, not the deliverable. Overall values here estimate reconstruction effort; the four milestones require end-to-end evidence.

Overall progress per commit

This is the overall estimate after each commit. Flat lines mean work did not yet change a measured leaf. Changes in the recorded leaf set or weights are marked as model revisions where available.

Legend: solid line = overall; dashed line = evidence-based; ○ replayed, ● recorded; vertical dotted rule = model revision; diamonds = evidence-based; dotted line with square markers = selected category.

The chart opens on the most recent 50 commits when there are more than 50. Use the range controls to browse or show all history, and the slider or pointer to inspect a commit. Selected ranges use a fitted vertical scale; all commits use a zero baseline. Objective progress counts git and local evidence; evidence-based progress also counts documented evidence. Solid line: overall including manual estimates. Dashed line: evidence-based progress only (basis git, local or documented), which includes documented counts. Estimates use the model in effect at each recording; model revisions can cause discontinuities. Points marked replay used the current components.json manual estimates and current ignored local outputs, so they are indicative. Hook-recorded points measure HEAD at commit time.
